title: Premium won’t work, customer service doesn’t respond
body: Can’t say if I like the app or not, since I’m unable to start using it properly. I purchased the premium version, which was charged from my credit card, but it won’t activate. I have emailed customer service twice, and Apple once - no response in two weeks, even though they claim to respond in a few business days at the latest.
author: Halomarikenb

title: Data lost
body: After using the app for years, the majority of the data disappeared after last update.
author: Pasi8

title: Tweaks
body: Love the look. I would like to log notes simultaneously with the actions- adding them separately is two clicks too many.
author: carolyoyoo

title: Annoying pop-up ad
body:
Every time I open the app it gives me 10 minutes to claim my offer. "Just for you - 9,99€ annually". And then the app store tries to fee me 59,99€. 

It's pretty annoying. But overall, I like the app.
author: Itudippi

title: Great tool but would like more customising options
body: It would be great if you were able to set some habits on monthly tracking and some routines as bi-weekly ones for example.
author: nooranoo

title: It was good
body: The app was really the best/most intuitive habit tracker app that I find. Until the recent update and they removed what were good about it (seeing streaks, switching between days, having weekly and daily habit in one place without grouping, but this last one is mostly to each’s taste). Now I need to find another app which is unwanted because my data is here. But I need to anyway since the streak is the thing that keeps me going.
author: HunterRay7944

title: Too many pop-up ads
body: Every time I open the app, there’s a pop-up ad. Very annoying, other than that the app is very reliable

title: Horrible
body: Nothing is really free.  Trouble to set.  Easier to set alarms as reminders. Don’t recommend it.

body:

title: Awesome!
body: Wonderful and useful app but there’s one problem: when I have set a goal weekly it doesn’t show it on the day filter even if I have tracked the goal to that day. Or is the filter’s idea to show just the tasks that you have marked daily? Oh sorry now I understand. It’s the tracked filter. So sorry.
